gaps.explanation: Statement lines (884,707) are the Total column of the modified cash proprietary statement pp11-12: operating 643,501 (user charges 622,083 + other operating 21,418) + nonoperating misc 23,021 + PPD lease 70,200 + sales tax 139,303 + interest income 8,682. Business-type detail holds only three budgetary-basis charge lines from the combined all-fund-types budget schedule p15 (Sewer 228,050, Water 226,161, Sanitation 172,100 = 626,311); the other operating revenues and all nonoperating revenues are missing, and the Water/Sanitation charges are budget-basis (statement prints 225,461 / 168,572). Fix (as FY2024, per-fund proprietary statement detail): remove the 3 budget charge lines (detail 90-92) and add every printed row of the Sewer / Water / Sanitation columns of pp11-12. Check: Sewer 228,050+21,418+553+70,200+139,303+5,154 = 464,678; Water 225,461+19,456+3,528 = 248,445; Sanitation 168,572+3,012 = 171,584; total 884,707. 626,311 + 884,707 - 626,311 = 884,707 = statement (gap 0). Business-type transfers in (Water 11,680) and capital contributions (Water 129,675, p12) are not added since they are not part of these gap rows.

gaps.explanation: Statement lines (807,206) = modified cash proprietary statement Total column: operating expenditures 641,583 + depreciation 147,025 (p11) + interest expense and issue costs 18,598 (p12). Business-type detail holds the combined all-fund-types budget schedule p17 lines (budgetary basis): Solid Waste operating 174,534, Wastewater operating 262,767, Water operating 201,462, capital lines 0 / 0 / 331,780 = 970,543. The budget basis includes Water capital outlay 331,780 (capitalized on the statement) and excludes depreciation; Wastewater 262,767 vs statement Sewer operating 265,587. Fix (as FY2024, per-fund proprietary statement detail): remove the 6 budget-schedule utility spending lines (detail 93-98: Solid Waste operating 174,534, Solid Waste capital 0, Wastewater operating 262,767, Wastewater capital 0, Water operating 201,462, Water capital 331,780) and add every printed spending row of the Sewer / Water / Sanitation columns of pp11-12. Check: Sewer 265,587 operating + 111,595 depreciation + 18,598 interest = 395,780; Water 201,462 + 35,430 = 236,892; Sanitation 174,534; total 807,206. 970,543 + 807,206 - 970,543 = 807,206 = statement (gap 0).
